title: Predatory Entity Schema
description: Unified JSON schema for validating predatory conferences and organizers in the CallForPaper predatory dataset repository.

slug.description: Kebab-case canonical slug identifying the entity.

name.description: Full official or advertised display name of the entity.

criteria_version.description: The criteria guideline version used when evaluating this entity.

first_flagged.description: YYYY-MM-DD date when the entity was first flagged.

last_updated.description: YYYY-MM-DD date when metadata or evidence was last updated.

last_reviewed.description: YYYY-MM-DD date when an editorial review was last completed.

domains.description: Domain names associated with this organizer (organizer only).

networks.description: Array of affiliated organizer slugs operating in the same network or syndicate.

organizer_slug.description: Slug of the parent organizer (conference only).

venue.description: Advertised city, venue, or location (conference only).

source_url.description: Primary advertised website or landing page URL (conference only).

red_flags.description: List of specific predatory indicators/red flags attached to this entity.

evidence.description: Audit trail and snapshots verifying observed red flags.

disputes.description: Formal disputes or review requests submitted for this entity.

id.description: Unique flag identifier within the entity, e.g. rf-1, rf-2.

type.description: Slug of the red flag type (e.g. same_day_same_venue_stacking, false_indexing_claims, fake_or_unverifiable_speakers, other).

description.description: Specific observation describing why this flag was raised.

first_observed.description: YYYY-MM-DD date when this specific flag was first observed.

last_confirmed.description: YYYY-MM-DD date when this flag was last verified active.

status.description: Whether this red flag is currently active or has been resolved.

evidence_refs.description: List of evidence IDs (e.g. ['ev-1', 'ev-2']) that support this red flag.

id.description: Unique evidence identifier within the entity, e.g. ev-1, ev-2.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD date when evidence was captured.

source_url.description: Original live URL from which evidence was captured.

snapshot_file.description: Key or relative path to stored raw HTML snapshot in repository or storage.

image_file.description: Relative path to a screenshot (png/jpg) inside evidence/<slug>/...

image_hash.description: Cryptographic hash (e.g. sha256) of captured image

content_hash.description: Cryptographic hash (e.g. sha256) of captured page content.

archive_org_url.description: Permanent archived URL on Wayback Machine (web.archive.org).

observed_by.description: Identifier or username of investigator / automated crawler.

notes.description: Observations or notes regarding this piece of evidence.

id.description: Unique dispute identifier within the entity, e.g. d-1.

opened_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD date when the dispute was opened.

claim.description: Summary of dispute statement or justification provided.

response_summary.description: Editorial response summary to the claim.

resolution_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD date when a resolution was reached.

resolved_by.description: Editor or reviewer who finalized the dispute.
